enrichment.summary: Ninyo & Moore, of Alameda, would do three tasks for the La Escuelita Educational Hazardous Soil Testing Project: 2024-2025 monitoring and reporting; 2026 through 2027 operation and maintenance repairs of the soil gas mitigation system (SGMS); and 2026-2027 semi-annual and annual SGMS monitoring. The not-to-exceed amount includes a $27,626.61 contingency. The term lasts for the duration of the project.
